title: ST-038 Camera light module interrupted operation repeats every Wednesday in shift hour 4
evidence: 4 of 4 Wednesdays (Nov 4, 11, 18, 25) at 09:08 on Kamera, typically 25 min: 87 min of downtime = 87 pcs lost, 1.13 pp of OEE over the period.

recommendation.action: Inspect, clean, and test camera lighting module intensity during autonomous maintenance at shift start.

title: Shift hour 1 (06:00–07:00) is consistently slow: 88.5% performance vs 94.5%
evidence: Performance 88.5% vs 94.5% median of the other hours, below the line median on 18 of 18 days (Nov 2 – Nov 25). Microstops 2.1 s per run minute vs 1.2, slowdown 4.4 vs 1.9. 53 pcs lost, 0.69 pp of OEE over the period.

recommendation.action: Complete autonomous maintenance checks and stage all necessary components prior to shift kickoff.

title: ST-047 Test nest allows air leakage repeats every Thursday in shift hour 3
evidence: 3 of 3 Thursdays (Nov 5, 12, 19) at 08:08 on Leak test, 15 min each: 45 min of downtime = 45 pcs lost, 0.59 pp of OEE over the period.

recommendation.action: Replace worn test nest sealing gaskets on a weekly preventive maintenance schedule.

title: Shift hour 5 (10:00–11:00) is consistently slow: 87.1% performance vs 94.5%
evidence: Performance 87.1% vs 94.5% median of the other hours, below the line median on 17 of 17 days (Nov 2 – Nov 24). Microstops 2.8 s per run minute vs 1.2, slowdown 4.2 vs 2.1. 38 pcs lost, 0.49 pp of OEE over the period.

recommendation.action: Ensure assembly line carriers and buffer materials are staged before the break concludes to enable immediate standard ramp-up.

title: Q-031 Product circuit allows fluid escape: #1 scrap cause, 33% of all NOK
evidence: 32 of 98 NOK pcs (32.7%, cumulative 32.7%) over 18 shifts, Nov 2 – Nov 25; 0.42 pp of OEE over the period.

recommendation.action: Conduct 5-Why root cause analysis on component sealing surfaces and supplier gasket tolerances.

title: Q-026 Threaded joint lacks required tightening: #2 scrap cause, 24% of all NOK
evidence: 24 of 98 NOK pcs (24.5%, cumulative 57.1%) over 18 shifts, Nov 2 – Nov 25; 0.31 pp of OEE over the period.

recommendation.action: Calibrate and verify electric screwdriver torque and angle settings at the start of every shift.

title: Q-020 Press-fit element short of target position: #3 scrap cause, 22% of all NOK
evidence: 22 of 98 NOK pcs (22.4%, cumulative 79.6%) over 18 shifts, Nov 2 – Nov 25; 0.29 pp of OEE over the period.

recommendation.action: Implement continuous press force and stroke position monitoring with an automated SPC alarm.
